visualLocks.primaryFace: Film4 alone supplies detailed actor face: source oval/angular Sigourney Weaver features, dark-brown shoulder-length curly hair with curled fringe. Film3 corroborates the same Ripley as second standing person from viewer-left; Parker/Dallas/Ash and all other crew excluded. Exact iris tint unresolved. Natural subdued nonluminous iris tonal intensity is supported by the film photograph; exact named hue remains unresolved. Do not render saturated cyan or luminous pale-blue irises, and do not force an unsupported brown/green label.
visualLocks.bodyCostume: Blue-gray zip-front Nostromo work coveralls, cream shirt collar and dark/olive inner shirt, rolled sleeves below elbows, small wing badge anatomical LEFT chest, yellow/red Nostromo upper-sleeve patches kept unreadable, two oblique upper-thigh zips. Licensed photograph supports full body/feet only; no plastic joint seams as anatomy.
visualLocks.watch: Black watch on anatomical LEFT wrist visible in licensed full-body support. Exact watch model unverified; no assertion that a cropped film frame proves it.
visualLocks.boots: Two gray ankle-high lace-up work boots with shafts mostly covered by trouser hems and broad gray toes/soles. Feet/boot construction are licensed body support rather than primary film full-body proof. No Bishop white-red sneakers in this selected costume. Precise visible profile refinement from the same unchanged licensed photo: LOW-PROFILE THIN CONTINUOUS RUBBER SOLE and shallow heel; no stacked platform or separate thick block heel. Keep gray lace upper/ankle construction. No shoe brand or eyelet count is newly certified.
visualLocks.sourceEquipment: Optional1979 gray improvised flamethrower from licensed photo: rear gray cylinder, gray pipe/body/guard, hanging red bottle, bent gray upper hose, complete black sling, short dark round perforated muzzle in oblique source angle. Exact opening count/hidden underside unknown; no M41/pulse rifle/rotary gun/1986 power loader. Source RIGHT hand grips weapon, LEFT watch stays visible; new choreography cannot invent new geometry. Only source-visible sling segments/attachment points are asserted; the photo partly occludes rear sling routing, so no fully exposed closed-loop geometry is invented.
visualLocks.optionalFilmHeadset: Film4 supports optional black headband/earpiece with thin mic only in a communications scene. Not permanent anatomy; film3 supports uncovered source hair.
visualLocks.excluded: Jonesy the cat, all crew other than the explicitly identified Ripley, toy face/plastic/joints, old generated atlas as authority, Aliens1986 short hair/pulse rifle/power-loader, Ripley8 clone, spacesuit instead of selected coveralls, fantasy armor. No unsourced external belt, gloves or holster.

scopeLimitations: The two distinct first-party film frames are consulted at their real source scope; only film4 is the detailed primary face authority. One copied/re-encoded file is not a new independent source. These images were retrieved by root; producer performed no new network request.

Licensed full-body figure is costume/equipment support only. The primary films do not independently show the complete boots or black LEFT watch in these exact frames. Hidden back surfaces and tiny lettering remain unknown; favor front/three-quarter source-supported views.
Chronological age and precise iris tint are not newly established; keep mature apparent source character, fully opaque family-safe nonromantic clothing and no numerical age claim.
Photographs provide source identity/structure, not target style. New artworks must be visibly square-cluster pixel art, no photographic/3D/toy render.

CG02 excludes the figure and Jonesy from its licensed photo. CG03 uses first-party film setting vocabulary only, with no people, creatures or face silhouettes. Other slots default to two actual attachments film4+licensed full-body, reducing contamination from film3 crew; film3 remains qualified consulted identity/setting support.

All locations are original compatible Alien1979 Nostromo/merchant-vessel interpretations unless clearly labelled FanArt/WhatIf/Nexus. No Colonial Marine/Aliens1986/Halo architecture or invented official scene claim.

Old atlas actually opened: green military-like costume, rifle and yellow power-loader blend designs beyond selected1979 blue-gray coveralls/gray lace-up boots/flamethrower. Preserve exact old bytes as a variant if later corrected.
